loreJson.text: A bright sliver broken from an amethyst growth, pure enough for optical lenses and fine crafting.
Pitch-black fossil fuel chipped from subterranean seams, catching a spark readily to fuel the roaring forge or light the path ahead.
A flawless crystal forged in the planet's deepest mantle, sharp-edged and gleaming with an unyielding icy-blue luster.
A radiant cut gem of rich verdant hue, universally coveted across village marketplaces as the supreme coin of commerce.
A permanently damp, pulsating blue orb recovered from sunken chests, humming with the deep song of the tides to awaken conduits.
A refined bar of smelted iron, dense, ductile, and uniform, serving as the foundational bedrock of all civilised toolcraft.
A radiant, pulsating celestial artifact claimed from the ashes of a slain Wither, crackling with raw, limitless power to crown beacon pyres.
An indestructible bar of alloy forged from ancient debris scrap and pure gold, floating upon molten lava and serving to elevate arms to divine perfection.
